settings.subtext: Marine collagen in a single sachet — precisely dosed, instantly dissolved, and scientifically formulated for absorption.

settings.heading: What's Inside
settings.content: Each sachet contains 5g Hydrolysed Marine Collagen (Type I & III), 80mg Vitamin C, 50mg Hyaluronic Acid, and 2,500mcg Biotin. Sustainably sourced from wild-caught fish. No artificial colours, flavours, or sweeteners.

settings.heading: How to Use
settings.content: Mix one sachet into 200ml of warm or cold water. Take daily in the morning — collagen synthesis is most active in the morning hours. Results compound over 4–8 weeks of consistent use.

settings.heading: The Science
settings.content: Natural collagen production drops 1–1.5% per year from age 25. Marine Collagen Type I is the most bioavailable form — its small peptides absorb more efficiently than bovine collagen. Pairing with Vitamin C is essential, as Vitamin C is a cofactor required for collagen synthesis in the body.
